SOURCE / CRAFT / TRANSPARENCY

A transparent
point of view.

Website and 3D visualisation by Muhammad Rizky. Rizky Atelier is an independent portfolio and digital gallery, not a furniture manufacturer, an official Living Ikon website, or an endorsement by a catalogue owner.

Walnut Bedroom / Ruang is an independent mid-century room study based on the owner's supplied reference. It is not a manufacturer catalogue and has no invented SKUs. Its original Blender Cycles master is 7680 × 5416 pixels; web images and material crops are viewing derivatives.

SIENNA 2026 and NEW HOI AN 2026 product references come from Living Ikon catalogues supplied by the owner. Fourteen SIENNA products and six HOI AN products retain their existing names, SKUs and printed dimensions. Product-card images are original catalogue crops, not this website's reconstructed renders. Original product designs and catalogue imagery remain with their respective rights holders; confirm permission with the catalogue owner for commercial redistribution.

The twenty catalogue crops are 800 × 600 pixels, with eighteen unique images. They are displayed at the available resolution without AI enhancement. “Original catalogue image” identifies the supplied source; the catalogue's original photography versus CGI is not independently verified. These are not calibrated physical wood/finish samples or proof of solid-wood construction. Confirm composition and finish with the supplier; colour and grain vary with lighting, screens and materials.

MADISON adds eight catalogue items from the owner-supplied MARINER CLASSIC FURNITURE CATALOG 2023, PDF pages13–20 (printed24–39). Original names, references and dimensions are retained; round-table width is the stated diameter. Seven product images preserve original embedded JPEG bytes; the armchair uses a documented native-resolution lifestyle crop. These are MARINER references, not Living Ikon products. Designs and catalogue-image rights remain with their respective owners; confirm commercial reuse permission.

The MADISON reconstruction includes twelve staged placements, modelled diamond tufting, bronze relief, marble insets and authored procedural PBR interpretations. Its native scene has seven cameras and four packed texture maps. Five actual Blender EEVEE renders are3840 × 2160; two detail renders are1600 × 1600. The source describes walnut burl veneer, not solid walnut. Exact hidden construction, cast motifs, finish/fabric calibration, veining and hidden table-leg count are interpretations. The TV centre panel stays fixed because no opening hardware is evidenced. The displayed exhibition is independently styled without walls or a roof.

TRIANON adds seven unique MARINER living-room references from the same supplied classic catalogue, PDF pages 21–24 (printed 40–47): three sage upholstered seating pieces, two Emperor marble coffee tables, one Calacatta console and one Emperor side table. The square coffee-table listing repeats in the source and counts once. The rectangular table has a shared detail composition rather than a separate isolated reference; its dimensions are printed, but its unseen proportions and construction are adapted. The contextual room spread contains other unlisted pieces, including vitrines and a round table, which are not relabelled as the seven selected SKUs.

TRIANON source images retain native pixel density. Where an original embedded image has a PDF soft mask, that original mask is faithfully composited over the original white page background; no new subject segmentation or AI enhancement is applied. Source image/mask hashes and transformations are recorded. The independent wall-free Blender scene has ten furniture placements, seven cameras and five packed authored PBR maps. Five actual EEVEE renders are 3840 × 2160, and two detail renders are 1600 × 1600. Gilded crest, scroll, acanthus, rosette and fluted-leg details are editable geometry. Exact carving topology, hidden construction, velvet calibration, veneer layout, antique-gold finish and marble veining are visual interpretations, not measured manufacturer samples or official CAD.

WELLINGTON adds fifteen MARINER living-room references from PDF pages 25–31 (printed 48–61). The navy family has hard medallion side panels, rear tufting and finials; the burgundy family has tufted outer sides and a smooth rear. The red two-seat SKU 50491.0 has printed dimensions but no isolated reference photo: its original three-seat family image is explicitly shared, never synthesised into a false two-seat catalogue image. The TV unit is a partial lifestyle crop, and mirror/console references retain styling and occlusions. Original embedded-image/PDF mirroring, native density, soft masks and all transformations are documented in source evidence.

The Wellington native scene has twenty wall-free furniture placements, ten cameras and five packed authored maps. Seven actual Blender EEVEE renders are 3840 × 2160; three details are 1600 × 1600. Black tabletops are lacquer with white inlay, not marble. The round coffee table has six legs; the square table four. The glass cabinet has two glass shelves and three levels. Cabinet/TV panels stay fixed; mirror exhibition stands are independent staging. Figured brown surfaces do not establish wood species or solid-wood construction. Hidden engineering, finish/fabric calibration and exact casting motifs remain visual interpretations, not official manufacturer CAD or endorsement.

These are authored visual reconstructions, not official manufacturer CAD or fabrication drawings. Concealed joinery, finish calibration, hardware, complementary styling and unseen surfaces are interpretations. SIENNA's tallboy name says “2 Over 4 Drawers” but the reference shows four broad fronts; the existing four-front model is retained. Both SIENNA and HOI AN share one catalogue bed image between Queen and King SKUs; both distinct widths are modelled. Dimensions are consistently width × depth × height, in millimetres.

SIENNA and HOI AN gallery images are actual Blender EEVEE renders, mostly derived from original 3840 × 2160 PNGs; HOI AN also has a 1600 × 2100 weave study. Walnut imagery is from its original Cycles scene. No AI-generated image replaces a native render. Browser models use real-time environment lighting; mirror reflections are not dynamic planar ray-traced room reflections. The exhibition LODs differ from full-detail product GLBs. Guided Tour is a curated camera sequence, not an AI assistant or a recorded video.
